tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Full-text search over the pages of stargogrowth.com (services, pricing, cases, answers, about, contact). Returns matching pages with URL and a short excerpt. Chinese pages are under /, English under /en/.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Returns the full Markdown of one stargogrowth.com page (same content as the web page, plus its JSON-LD). Accepts a path like "/services/" or a full https://stargogrowth.com URL.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Lists the pages of stargogrowth.com with title and URL, optionally for one section (services, cases, answers, about, contact) and language.

tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Runs 14 real, read-only checks of a public website homepage: reachability, HTTPS, indexability, robots.txt, search and AI crawler access, sitemap, title, meta description, H1, canonical, language, structured data, server-rendered text and /llms.txt. No scores are invented; each check shows what was

tools.name: request_consultation
tools.description: Sends the user's question to the Stargo Growth team (it arrives in their support inbox and they reply by email). Only call this when the user explicitly asked to contact Stargo Growth and provided their own email address. Returns delivered:true only when the inbox confirmed receipt; otherwise an err

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site, get_page, list_pages · Private data: search_site, list_pages, request_consultation · Public sink: request_consultation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site, get_page, list_pages · Private data: search_site, list_pages, request_consultation · Public sink: request_consultation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
